name: SUDESTADA at Durban (TNPA Tariff Book 2024/25)
query: What port dues will the bulk carrier SUDESTADA (Malta flag, built 2010) pay at Durban? She is 51,300 GT, 31,192 NT and 93,274 DWT, 229.2 m long with a 38 m beam and a 14.9 m draft. She arrives on 15 November 2024 at 10:12 and sails on 22 November 2024 at 13:00, spending 3.39 days alongside to load 40,000 tonnes of iron ore for export.

expected.label: Running Lines
expected.note: The reference value equals §3.8 Berthing services; §3.9 Running of vessel lines is priced separately.
